description: YOLOX head decode + NMS fixture (BASE-1 6.11/M1.9). bin = raw [1,3,7] float32 (little-endian) output tensor, rows [x1,y1,x2,y2,obj,c0,c1] in 416x416 model-canvas pixels; scores already sigmoid. Decode with score 0.25 then class-aware NMS at IoU 0.5: anchor 3 is suppressed by anchor 2. Expected boxes hand-calculated from the pixel values.
